title: Warn when missing Power BI Account Categories Mappings
summary: A warning notification alerts users when Power BI Account Categories Mappings are missing during finance setup, helping them identify a common configuration issue.
key_points: Detects missing Power BI Account Categories Mappings in the Power BI Reports Setup
Displays a warning notification to users when the mappings are not configured
Addresses a frequent customer issue with Power BI integration
Added to Finance Installation Handler to trigger during finance setup
quote: Surfacing a common gotcha in customer scenarios.
